verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਭੂਲਿ ਬਛੁਰਾ ਪਰਤ ਆਨ ਗਾਇ ਥਨ ਬਹੁਰਿਓ ਮਿਲਤ ਮਾਤ ਬਾਤ ਨ ਸਮਾਰ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise bhool bachhuraa parat aan gai than bahurio milat maat baat na samaar hai ||

en.bdb: Just as a calf goes to another cow for milk by mistake, and on coming back to his mother, she does not recall his mistake and feeds him.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਆਨ ਸਰ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਆਵੈ ਮਾਨਸਰ ਹੰਸ ਦੇਤ ਮੁਕਤਾ ਅਮੋਲ ਦੋਖ ਨ ਬੀਚਾਰ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise aan sar bhram aavai maanasar ha(n)s dhet mukataa amol dhokh na beechaar hai ||

en.bdb: Just as a swan reaches Mansarover lake after wandering to various other lakes, Mansarover lake does not remind him his mistake and serves him with pearls.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਨ੍ਰਿਪ ਸੇਵਕ ਕਉ ਆਨ ਦੁਆਰ ਹਾਰ ਆਵੈ ਚਉਗਨੋ ਬਢਾਵੈ ਨ ਅਵਗਿਆ ਉਰਿਧਾਰ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise nirap sevak kau aan dhuaar haar aavai chaugano baddaavai na avagiaa uridhaar hai ||

en.bdb: Just as a royal attendant, after wandering all over comes back to his master who does not recall him his departure and instead raises his status many time more.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਅਸਰਨਿ ਸਰਨਿ ਦਇਆਲ ਦੇਵ ਸਿਖਨ ਕੋ ਭੂਲਿਬੋ ਨ ਰਿਦ ਮੈ ਨਿਹਾਰ ਹੈ ॥੪੪੪॥
verses.translit_en: satigur asaran saran dhiaal dhev sikhan ko bhoolibo na ridh mai nihaar hai ||444||

en.bdb: Similarly, the radiant and benevolent True Guru is the support of the destitute. He does not keep in mind the mistakes of those Sikhs who have separated themselves from the door of their Guru and are wandering on the door of gods and goddesses.  (444)
